title: Lulu and the Puddles | Bedtime Story for Kids
description:
A little rain cloud comes and Lulu the little duck opens her umbrella. Drip, drop!
The rain stops, the sun comes out, and Lulu finds a puddle. Splash, splash, splash! Frog hops in to splash too.
Then a rainbow, the sun goes down, and Lulu and Frog sleep by the puddle.
A happy rainy-day story for children aged 3 to 6.
